<title level="1" right="Class Feature 15">[Revolutionary Innovation](/Classes.aspx?ID=19)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 15

**Class** Inventor
</column>

---

You are an unparalleled genius and have discovered a technique that will revolutionize your chosen field—or at least for the time being, your [innovation](Innovations.aspx)! Choose a revolutionary modification to apply to your innovation. You can also choose an initial or breakthrough modification of the same type instead, if you prefer.
name: Revolutionary Innovation
